podcast.body: Originally released on the 1971 album 'Hunky Dory', "Changes" first climbed to number 66 in 1972. RCA reissued it in January 1975, promoting it as Bowie's ultimate statement of purpose, embodying his lyrical declaration of needing to be a "different man." However, this reissue stalled at number 41, just missing the American Top 40 again.
